received_proposals.exact_message: We have successfully maintained the profitable cartel of 16 units each for seven rounds. To maximize our cumulative joint profits, I propose we continue this agreement by producing 16 units again in Round 8.

Following our discussion, I ask A and B to agree to produce 16 units each in rounds 9 through 13 only. This requires an allocation of A=16, B=16, C=16. Please confirm your consent for this specific window so we can proceed together.

assessments.brief_explanation: Proposes limited window; accepts if agreed.
